description: First run once the API key works: three candidate art directions, each shown as an exterior key art (train in the wasteland) and an interior key art (cutaway carriage with survivors). The user picks one; it becomes art/anchor/style_anchor.png. 9 images total.

subjects.exterior: Key art for a mobile game: a long steam locomotive with a big snowplough pulling six patched, armoured carriages across a frozen post-apocalyptic wasteland at blue-hour dusk, light snowfall. Warm amber light glows from every carriage window and from the firebox. Background: snow-buried ruins of a city and a frozen dead forest; a faint aurora in the sky. The train is seen exactly from the side and fills the lower middle third of the frame.
subjects.interior: Key art for a mobile game: one train carriage shown as a cutaway cross-section. Inside is a cosy improvised home for survivors: bunk beds, a small iron stove with a glowing fire, hanging lamps, pipes along the ceiling, crates and patched blankets. Four survivors in warm winter clothes (fur hats, scarves, goggles) do everyday tasks: one cooks at the stove, one repairs a pipe, one reads in a bunk, a child warms their hands. Through the windows in the back wall: a snowy landscape at night.
